== Summary ==
'''CardMaker recreation''' of [[Fleet Security Protocols]] (<code>2261_34</code>), showing the '''original''' game text. No published card image shows this text: the Virtual Block 6 release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB6-34-Fleet_Security_Protocols.png]]) and the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB6-D-fleetsecurityprotocols-pre.gif]]) both show the PC-E1 text of [[Fleet Security Protocols (Errata)]] (the revised sheet).

* '''Text source:''' first copy of the Virtual Block 6.1 (Reflections IV) release sheet (“Official text as of September 4, 2009”; attachment Block6WithRebelFleetV.pdf on the [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=1375528 Players Committee forum]). The ▼ and Immune to Alter icons are placed as on the revised sheet's slip.
* '''original text:''' “Deploy on table. During battle involving your starship (or vehicle), it is power +2 for each character at its related sites (those characters may be forfeited to reduce battle damage and attrition). Once per turn, may ▼ a non-unique starship (or vehicle) site (if such sites leave table, place them and all your cards there in Used Pile). [Immune to Alter]”
* '''Made:''' 8 November 2026 with the SWCCG CardMaker (https://swccg.com/cardmaker/, repo billbisco/swccg-cardmaker, STANDARD rev 71) from the card's own Virtual Legacy card (Decipher art, frame, title, lore, icons, Virtual Block 6 set mark, slip number, copyright line) with this game text. Holotable size, 745 × 1039. Rebuild spec: <code>VB6-34-Fleet_Security_Protocols-original-cardmaker.png.spec.json</code> in the batch B09 run folder.
* '''Not an official image.''' Card art and design © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc.; virtual card text by the Star Wars CCG Players Committee.
